hypotheses: OSI-027 (2 uM, 24 h) in A375 produces a coordinated decrease in H3K27 methylation/acetylation states on K36me2/me1/me0 backgrounds, consistent with a histone perturbation rather than a single-mark artifact.
Donors with high anchor similarity to the OSI-027 A375 histone profile are more likely to transfer a reproducible histone response in the fixed external decoder.

Etoposide, Resveratrol, Bortezomib, Carfilzomib, and flavopiridol are prioritized because their measured anchor similarities are among the highest available and they have known chromatin, stress, or proteostasis-related pharmacology that could plausibly perturb histone marks.
CPI-169 and BIX-01294 are mechanistically relevant histone methyltransferase inhibitors but have low or negative anchor similarity, so they are not selected as transfer donors for this query.
